# Mixed pressure in a partial merged span

Twelve original controls generated by `tools/mixed_pressure_partial_fixture.py`
from mixed-width-protection. The 5000-twip protected footer spans all columns
except the last automatic cell. First/second/neither protected absolute cells,
two/three automatic cells and 6000/6001-twip table widths remain paired.
The reference application's logical grid is captured by the shared recorder without saving the source.
Source and manifest hashes bind the reference; no corpus assets or font binaries
are included. These are logical grid observations, not PDF paint references.

Eight grids match exactly. Four retain at most two twips (0.1pt) of width or
cumulative-boundary error. The browser test explicitly enforces that bound
through editing, undo and reopening; it does not label the residual exact.
The previous renderer misses some of these boundaries by hundreds of twips.
Whole-table pressure cases remain subject to exact whole-twip assertions.
Relevant ECMA-376 clauses and compatibility interpretation are recorded in
`docs/conformance.md`; no normative specification conflict is claimed.
